Trailhead 40 L Backpack

A 40-litre hiking pack built around a ventilated back panel, with a floating lid that adds another six litres when the main compartment is full.

The hip belt carries most of the load and comes in two widths, so the same frame works for a range of torso lengths without an aftermarket swap.

Specifications

Volume
40 L (+6 L lid)
Weight
1.35 kg
Material
210D ripstop nylon
